BiblicalUsage: The name is Ritsjah, an Israelite. You find the name in 1 Chronicles 7:39: "…sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Ritsjah counts, because God wrote the name down and I believe he meant it. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
